review:
Finger Lick'n Free Spins is a farmyard slot where hens sit above each reel and can drop eggs at random. Three or more eggs in one spin trigger the bonus.

Before free spins begin, three more eggs appear on each reel where an egg dropped, revealing 1–3 free spins, a prize up to 100x, or a wild that moves to a new position on every spin. Golden eggs reveal bigger rewards: 5–15 free spins, a wild carrying a multiplier up to 20x, or a prize up to 2,000x. Hens keep dropping eggs during the bonus, which can retrigger it. The RTP is 96.55%, and Pragmatic Play doesn't list a max win on its page.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
